capabilities: Render a standalone [TOC] line as a nested, clickable table of contents
Jump to the clicked heading, resolving duplicate heading names by line position
Render inline Markdown markup in headings as formatted text
Fold non-contiguous heading levels into relative indentation
Configure heading level range and optional 1.2.3 numbering
disambiguation: Not a sidebar outline panel; it only renders a [TOC] marker placed inside the note body.
extras: Pending Obsidian staff review; before acceptance it can be installed via BRAT or manually. README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and includes a full Chinese-language section.
problem: Obsidian shows the Typora [TOC] marker as a dead, unclickable blue link instead of a generated table of contents.

relations.evidence: Non-contiguous heading levels (an H4 directly under an H2) fold into relative indentation, like Typora.

summary: Renders a Typora-style [TOC] line as a clickable, nested table of contents in both reading view and Live Preview.
